DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilic Arthropathy (Secondary to Hemophilia)

The MRI confirms significant hemarthrosis (bleeding into the joint) without structural damage or trauma, which strongly suggests a bleeding disorder like hemophilia causing recurrent joint bleeds, especially given your family history.
